path: 上達のためのテクニック

intro.ja:
棒銀の囲いは相手の戦型と攻める速さで選びます。矢倉は正面に強い反面手数が必要です。カニ囲いは早いですが薄く、反撃への備えを読みます。角交換のある将棋では、カブト囲いで角打ちの隙を減らす考え方があります。

振り飛車には舟囲いが基本候補です。７九銀型と６八金型では守備駒の配置や発展の余地が違います。攻めの銀が前へ出た後に残る守りと、相手の角や飛車の進路を確認し、囲う手数と攻めの速度を両立させましょう。
intro.en:
Choose the castle from the opponent’s opening and the time available. Yagura offers frontal resistance but takes preparation; Crab Castle develops quickly with a thinner defense. Helmet Castle can reduce bishop-drop weaknesses in bishop-exchange games. None of these names guarantees safety: inspect the actual gaps and counterattacks before sending the silver forward.

Boat Castle is a practical option against Ranging Rook. Its silver-on-7i and gold-on-6h forms leave different defenders and development possibilities. Consider what remains around your king after the attacking silver advances, and how the opponent’s rook and bishop can reach it. Balance the time spent castling with the timing of your attack.

question.ja: カニ囲いの交換条件は？
question.en: What tradeoff comes with Crab Castle?

answer.ja: 早く組める代わりに守りが薄くなります。
answer.en: It develops quickly at the cost of a thinner defense.

courses.title: 棒銀で使われる囲い: 図1-1 棒銀の基本の形
courses.titleEn: Castles for Climbing Silver: Figure 1-1: Basic form of Climbing Silver
courses.goalFormation:
図1-1 棒銀の基本の形
図1-1は棒銀の基本の形です。飛車・銀・歩が一直線に並ぶのが特徴で、シンプルながら強力な攻撃の陣形です。今回は、この棒銀と合わせて使われる守りの陣形を解説します。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Basic form of Climbing Silver
Figure 1-1 is the basic Climbing Silver shape. Rook, silver and pawn line up on one file, a simple but powerful attacking formation. Here we explain the defensive formations used along with Climbing Silver.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.titleEn: Castles for Climbing Silver: Figure 2-1: Yagura castle
courses.goalFormation:
図2-1 矢倉囲い
棒銀で使われる定番の囲いは矢倉囲いです。囲うのに手数がかかる代わりに、玉をしっかり守れます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 2-1: Yagura castle
The standard castle used with Climbing Silver is Yagura. It takes many moves to build but protects the king firmly.

courses.title: 棒銀で使われる囲い: 図2-2 カニ囲い
courses.titleEn: Castles for Climbing Silver: Figure 2-2: Crab castle
courses.goalFormation:
図2-2 カニ囲い
カニ囲いは、矢倉囲いより少ない手数で囲えるのが魅力です。玉の守りは薄いですが、素早く攻めたい人におすすめの囲いで、カニ囲いから通常の矢倉囲いに発展させることもできます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 2-2: Crab castle
Kani-gakoi's appeal is that it can be built in fewer moves than Yagura. The king's defence is thin, but it suits those who want to attack quickly, and it can develop into ordinary Yagura.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.title: 棒銀で使われる囲い: 図2-3 兜矢倉
courses.titleEn: Castles for Climbing Silver: Figure 2-3: Helmet Yagura
courses.goalFormation:
図2-3 兜矢倉
兜矢倉は、角交換の将棋でよく使われる囲いです。少ない手数で囲え、自陣に角を打たれる隙が少ないのも利点で、兜矢倉から通常の矢倉囲いに発展させることもできます。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 2-3: Helmet Yagura
Kabuto Yagura is often used in bishop exchange games. It can be built in few moves and offers fewer holes for a bishop drop into your camp, and it can develop into ordinary Yagura.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.

courses.title: 棒銀で使われる囲い: 図3-1 7九銀型舟囲い
courses.titleEn: Castles for Climbing Silver: Figure 3-1: Boat castle with 7九銀
courses.goalFormation:
図3-1 7九銀型舟囲い
相手が振り飛車を取ってきたときは、矢倉囲いよりも舟囲いに組むのがおすすめです。舟囲いは縦からの攻めに弱いので相居飛車では使われませんが、横からの攻めには意外と耐久力があります。相手が振り飛車なら舟囲いが基本の囲いです。
原図に描かれた駒だけを置いています。

root.commentEn:
Figure 3-1: Boat castle with 7九銀
When the opponent plays Ranging Rook, building Funagakoi is recommended over Yagura. Funagakoi is weak against frontal attacks so it is not used in double Static Rook, but it is surprisingly durable against lateral ones. Against Ranging Rook, Funagakoi is the basic castle.
Only the pieces drawn in the source figure are placed.
